# openmetadata_glossary Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata glossary by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_glossary" "finance" {
  fully_qualified_name = "finance"
}

output "finance_glossary_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_glossary.finance.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Glossary fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Glossary UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether a term may belong to only one glossary under the same parent.
- `name` (String) Glossary name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
